title: Scroll of Biting
move_pattern: Starter move varies based on spawn (can begin with Chomp, Chew, or More Teeth). Generally cycles: Chomp → More Teeth → Chew → random branch. The random branch picks either Chomp or Chew, with Chew being more likely, then repeats.
notes: Applies Paper Cuts power (amount 2) when entering combat. Damage values scale at Ascension 9 (Deadly Enemies), while HP scales at Ascension 8 (Tough Enemies).
